name: The Tower at Boca Raton
insider_take: This iconic pink palace has been Boca Raton's crown jewel since 1928, originally built by visionary architect Addison Mizner who shaped South Florida's distinctive Mediterranean Revival style.
whats_special: The Tower sits on the only private beach club in Boca Raton and features the legendary Cloister—a historic architectural masterpiece with hand-painted ceilings and original Mizner details. The resort spans both sides of the Intracoastal Waterway, connected by a private yacht that shuttles guests between properties.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the Beach Club's oceanfront terrace during sea turtle nesting season (May-October) for a chance to witness these magnificent creatures in their natural habitat.
dont_miss: The world-class Spa Palmera, voted one of America's top resort spas, and a round of golf on the resort's championship course designed by Joe Lee. Take the complimentary yacht transfer at golden hour for Instagram-worthy shots of Boca's stunning waterways.
pros: Elegant tower hotel with sophisticated accommodations
Prime Boca Raton location with upscale amenities
Premium boutique property with personalized service
cons: Intimate boutique size may limit facility options
